data.job_description:
About Wilmington Health

Since 1971, Wilmington Health has been committed to the care and health of our community in Wilmington as well as all of Southeastern North Carolina. Wilmington Health is structured as a multi-specialty medical practice with primary care providers integrated into the system. In this way, Wilmington Health is able to provide a comprehensive and coordinated approach to the care of all our patients. Wilmington Health is committed to using collaborative, evidence-based medicine in providing the highest quality of care to the patients we serve.

Purpose:

Wilmington Health is seeking a Business Intelligence/SQL Analyst to support data-driven decision making across the organization. This position requires proficiency in business intelligence and data tools to extract, transform, and analyze healthcare data. The Analyst is responsible for developing reports, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support strategic initiatives and operational improvements.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

• Analyze large data sets to determine appropriate logic to incorporate into existing processes to discover trends, relationships, and produce actionable insights to inform strategy, improve quality, and identify cost reduction opportunities.

• Create SSIS packages to extract, transform, and load large data sets.

• Develop efficient SQL procedures to support reporting.

• Develop, maintain, and enhance business intelligence reports, using Power BI, to visualize trends, KPIs, and operational metrics.

• Create and maintain documentation of all processes.

• Present thoughtful analytical summaries and findings to internal and external stakeholders.

• Assist with meetings, presentations, and communications regarding data projects and insights.

• Collaborate with clinical, operational, and IT stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Conduct ad hoc analyses of healthcare and/or business operational data.

• Maintain strict confidentiality and adhere to all data governance and compliance standards.

• Appear for work on time and attend meetings as required.

• Communicate professionally and appropriately with patients, physicians, coworkers, and external stakeholders

• Perform other duties specified by manager

**NOT open to Sponsorship at this time**

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

• Proficient in SQL coding, including the creation of stored procedures.

• Experience with SSIS for data loading and processing.

• Experience developing business intelligence reports; Power BI preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Detail-oriented with the ability to handle multiple priorities.

• Effective and professional written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficient with MS Office applications.

• Familiarity with healthcare or health insurance data preferred.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• 1+ years experience in SQL, SSIS, and Power BI

We are committed to treating everyone equally and with respect regardless of race, age, sex, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual preference, disability, genetic information, or any other class protected under state or federal law.

Position Description:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to provide actionable insights into portfolio performance, focusing on value delivery, flow efficiency, and outcomes rather than traditional status reporting. This role translates complex delivery data into clear insights that drive prioritization, funding, and strategic decisions.

We partner with 15 of the top 20 banks globally, and our top 10 banking clients have worked with us for an average of 26 years!.

This role is located at a client site in either Reston, VA. A hybrid working model is acceptable.

Your future duties and responsibilities:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to provide actionable insights into portfolio performance, focusing on value delivery, flow efficiency, and outcomes rather than traditional status reporting. This role translates complex delivery data into clear insights that drive prioritization, funding, and strategic decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

. Track value realization, throughput, cycle time, and bottlenecks

. Design and maintain portfolio dashboards focused on value and flow metrics

. Translate technical delivery signals into business-relevant insights

. Support continuous prioritization and investment decisions

. Ensure visibility into AI/ML initiative impact and value delivery

. Integrate data from ServiceNow, GitLab, AWS, and other systems

. Improve data quality, consistency, and usability

. Enable executive-level storytelling around value delivery and outcomes

Required qualifications to be successful in this role:

. 7+ years in analytics, program, or portfolio reporting roles

. Strong experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

. Experience with flow metrics and Lean/Agile reporting models

. Ability to translate engineering metrics into business outcomes

. Familiarity with AWS data environments and pipelines

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field

About Us

Bayland Health is a fast-growing cross-platform e-commerce technology company with a strong presence across Amazon, TikTok Shop, and other digital commerce channels. We leverage technology, analytics, supply chain strength, and operational excellence to support scalable growth across multiple brands and marketplaces.

Our team is focused on building data-driven processes, improving operational visibility, and helping business teams make smarter, faster decisions.

About This Role

Bayland Health is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our growing Data Team in Montclair, CA. This is an early-career role ideal for a recent graduate or someone with 0–2 years of hands-on experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related field.

In this role, you will help build dashboards, maintain recurring reports, analyze business performance, and support data-driven decision-making across sales, marketing, inventory, operations, supply chain, and finance. You will work closely with the Data Team lead and cross-functional business partners to turn raw business data into clear, accurate, and actionable insights.

The ideal candidate has strong SQL fundamentals, working knowledge of Python, experience with BI/reporting tools, and a strong interest in e-commerce analytics. We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, curious, reliable, willing to learn, and excited to grow with the company long term.

What You’ll Do
• Build, maintain, and improve dashboards and recurring reports for sales, marketing, inventory, operations, and leadership teams.
• Use SQL and Python to clean, transform, validate, and analyze business data from multiple sources.
• Support KPI tracking and business performance reporting across e-commerce platforms, marketplaces, and internal operations.
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into clear analytical outputs.
• Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across sales, marketing, inventory, customer behavior, and operational data.
• Help improve data accuracy, consistency, and reporting reliability through validation checks and standardized definitions.
• Support data integration, reporting automation, and basic ETL/ELT workflows under the guidance of the Data Team lead.
• Create clear visualizations, summaries, and insights that help non-technical teams understand business performance.
• Assist with self-service reporting initiatives to improve data accessibility across teams.
• Maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, business definitions, and data processes.
• Contribute to future analytics automation and AI-enabled reporting projects as the data function continues to grow.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
• 0–2 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting, data operations, or a related area.
• Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, filtering, and basic data transformation.
• Working knowledge of Python for data analysis, automation, or data cleaning.
• Experience creating reports, dashboards, or data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools.
• Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to identify data issues and explain findings clearly.
• Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical team members.
• Interest in e-commerce, marketplace, operations, marketing, inventory, or supply chain analytics.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, hands-on business environment.
• Willingness to work onsite in Montclair, CA.
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Bayland Health is unable to provide employment visa sponsorship for this position.

Preferred Qualifications
• Internship, academic project, or work experience involving SQL, Python, dashboarding, reporting, or data analysis.
• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or other BI tools.
• Experience analyzing sales, marketing, inventory, customer, or operational data.
• Familiarity with Amazon, TikTok Shop, Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, or other e-commerce platforms.
• Exposure to APIs, ETL/ELT workflows, data modeling, or cloud-based analytics tools.
• Familiarity with Git/GitHub, dbt, Airflow, AWS, Spark, Databricks, or similar tools is a plus, but not required.
• Exposure to forecasting, experimentation, statistical analysis, or near real-time reporting is a plus.
• Interest in AI-enabled analytics, automation workflows, and emerging data technologies.
• Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a plus due to collaboration with cross-functional and overseas teams.
• Strong learning mindset, ownership, reliability, and interest in growing within a fast-paced e-commerce business.

What Makes This Role Exciting
• Early-career opportunity to grow within a fast-growing e-commerce technology company.
• Hands-on exposure to real business data across Amazon, TikTok Shop, and other digital commerce channels.
• Opportunity to work closely with business, operations, marketing, inventory, and leadership teams.
• Direct mentorship and guidance from the Data Team lead.
• Strong learning opportunities in BI, SQL, Python, data modeling, automation, and e-commerce analytics.
• Opportunity to contribute to the company’s long-term analytics foundation.
• Exposure to future AI-enabled analytics and reporting automation initiatives.
• A practical, business-facing data role with strong long-term growth potential.

Salary and Benefits

Pay: $65,000 - $75,000 per year plus bonus incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, education, and business needs.

Benefits include:
• Medical, dental, and vision insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid time off
• Paid sick leave
• Paid holidays
• Free office snacks and drinks
• Performance-based bonus opportunities

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Bayland Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, immigration status, protected veteran status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

About Community Change and Community Change Action

Community Change builds the power and capacity of low‑income people, especially people of color, to lead powerful and dynamic movements for social change. With our community‑based partner groups, we bridge the grassroots and the national, supporting outsider strategies to disrupt the status quo while building pathways to influence insider conversations.

Our vision centers the leadership of impacted people of color to advance immigrant rights, economic justice, and racial equity, focusing on jobs and housing, early childhood care and education, income supports, and immigration reform.

This position also supports Community Change Action, an affiliated 501(c)(4) advocacy organization. While motivated by the same core values – equity, inclusion, and justice – both organizations operate independently with separate boards.
Position Description

The Business Intelligence Specialist will harness internal and external datasets to empower Community Change’s mission for social, economic justice, and the goal of abolishing poverty. By designing advanced analytics solutions, the specialist will extract actionable insights from a variety of data sources to inform strategy and measure impact. The role involves collaboration across teams to ensure data‑driven decision‑making, integration and optimization of BI platforms, and creation of unified dashboards and reports on organizational metrics.
Principal Responsibilities
• Collect, analyze, and interpret internal and external datasets to provide actionable insights for strategic decision‑making.
• Design, develop, and implement advanced analytics solutions to inform organizational strategy and measure impact.
• Collaborate across teams to foster a culture of data‑driven decision making and integrate business intelligence platforms.
• Create unified dashboards and reports on organizational performance and progress.
• Develop and maintain robust data models and governance processes to ensure high data quality and reliability.
• Monitor and assess emerging BI technologies, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance analytical capabilities and operational efficiency.
• Serve as the infrastructure data subject‑matter expert (SME) for Community Change/Action.
• Create and deliver training sessions for staff on data literacy, analytical tools, and effective interpretation of BI outputs.
• Regularly evaluate organizational KPIs and design custom metrics to measure outcomes and progress toward strategic goals.
• Serve as a SME on BI, guiding leadership and staff on leveraging data for advocacy, storytelling, and program optimization.
• Establish standardized data governance frameworks and protocols to ensure consistency and integrity across all systems.
• Coordinate with cross‑functional teams to consolidate data sources and eliminate redundancies, fostering a single source of truth.
• Implement centralized data management tools and platforms that streamline data collection, storage, and access throughout the organization.
• Develop and enforce organization‑wide policies for data security, privacy, and compliance, ensuring adherence to best practices and regulatory requirements.
• Lead regular audits and data quality assessments, providing actionable insights and recommendations to continually improve data management processes and outcomes.
Qualifications
• Proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker, with demonstrated ability to design interactive dashboards and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
• Advanced skills in querying databases using SQL, and experience with ETL processes to prepare and integrate large datasets from multiple sources.
• Solid understanding of statistical analysis and data modeling techniques, including experience using DAX, Python, or R for data manipulation and predictive analytics.
• Demonstrated expertise in delivering training sessions on data literacy, analytical tools, and business intelligence concepts to diverse staff audiences.
• Proven ability to design and evaluate custom metrics and KPIs that measure program effectiveness and align with strategic objectives.
• Strong background in BI practices, including guidance to leadership and staff on effective data utilization for advocacy, storytelling, and program improvements.
• Experience in standardizing and centralizing data practices across complex organizations to maintain consistent methodologies and protocols.
• In‑depth knowledge of data governance frameworks and the development and enforcement of protocols that maintain data integrity and consistency.
• Ability to coordinate across cross‑functional teams to consolidate data sources, eliminate redundancies, and foster a unified source of organizational information.
• Hands‑on experience with centralized data management platforms and tools for streamlined data collection, storage, and accessibility.
• Thorough understanding of data security, privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements, with a record of developing and upholding organization‑wide policies.
• Strong writing and editing skills.
• Computer literacy required, including MS Office Suite and G‑Suite; familiarity with Slack, Salesforce, and Zoom is a plus.
• Excellent interpersonal communication skills, diplomacy, and discretion.
• Team player with the capacity to be resourceful and flexible.
• Commitment to advancing economic and gender and racial justice.

data.job_title: Market & Business Intelligence Analyst at DLA Piper in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
data.job_description:
Market & Business Intelligence Analyst

DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let's see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary The Market & Business Intelligence Analyst, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm's strategic initiatives, conducts extensive research on current and potential clients. Analyzes search results, compiles reports and analyzes the firm's clients, prospects, key industries, competitors and new markets.

Location This position can sit in our Reston, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Raleigh, San Diego, Seattle, Short Hills, Washington DC, or Wilmington office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities
• Identifies market trends, industry developments, client movements and other relevant client news in an effort to provide information for the firm's marketing and business development department, attorneys, firm leadership, and other stakeholders.
• Conducts extensive research on current and potential clients using web sources and internal data to assist in identifying potential areas of cross-selling and targeting opportunities in providing legal services.
• Analyzes search results, compiles reports and provides a written executive summary. Provides information critical to the firm's business development and competitive advantage initiatives.
• Analyzes the firm's clients, prospects, key industries serviced, and competitors and identify new markets. Supports client pitches and provides needed information for responding to RFPs.
• Assists management with developing a highly functioning global competitive intelligence research and business analysis group by contributing ideas, suggestions, and using information and tools not typically found in a law firm.
• Other duties as assigned.

Desired Skills Must have strong analytical skills to gather, analyze and interpret a variety of data information. Knowledge of the legal market and competitors is a plus. Strong communication and interpersonal skills required to interact with staff of all levels. Must have experience using AI to conduct research. Must be fluent in data gathering and analysis, including organizing and manipulating data in Excel spreadsheets using basic and advanced functions. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Must be able to extract insights and produce recommendations from market and client research. Competency in data management and visualization tools such as Power BI and Alteryx are a plus.

Minimum Education
• Bachelor's Degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Business, Library Services or related field.

Preferred Education
• Master's Degree in MBA, MS, MLIS, or related master's degree a plus.

Minimum Years of Experience
• 3 years' experience in marketing research or knowledge services.

Essential Job Expectations While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:
• Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties.
• Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner.
• Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product.
• Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required.
• Foster positive work relationships.
• Comply with all firm policies and practices.
• Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed.
• Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
• Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people. Physical Demands Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Work Environment The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm's discretion in the future.

Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst who is passionate about transforming data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions and business performance. In this role, you will partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver impactful analytics and business intelligence solutions that improve visibility into key metrics and support strategic decision-making across the organization.

You will lead the full lifecycle of business intelligence initiatives - from gathering requirements and prototyping solutions to developing dashboards, validating results, and supporting deployment. Leveraging modern data platforms and visualization tools, you will translate complex datasets into intuitive reporting and actionable insights that empower teams to better understand their data and make informed decisions.

This role works closely with business partners, data teams, and technology stakeholders to continuously improve how data is accessed, analyzed, and used across the organization.

Location: This position is located at our Dublin, OH campus with hybrid flexibility or may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

• Champion data quality, integrity, and reliability throughout the department by designing and promoting best practices.

• Organize and lead design, code & process review sessions.

• Focus and passion to deliver error-free analysis and reports.

• Serve as SME and lead developer for key initiatives creating project plans with estimation and guiding the development team in best solution approach

• Participate in business process improvement, quality control and other initiatives.

• Engage and partner with internal stakeholders and project managers to elicit and document functional and technical requirements; Provide recommendations where requirements aren’t clearly defined / known.

• Prototype and iterate with internal stakeholders to help solidify requirements and expectations.

• Utilize various approaches and technologies to gather and prepare data, including: query development (SQL Server, Snowflake) and using BI platforms like QuickSight, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, SSRS, etc.

• Provide data analysis and design reports, dashboards and visualizations.

• Perform rigorous unit testing and coordinate UAT where applicable to help ensure quality data products are delivered.

• Partner with development operations to deploy business intelligence solutions.

• Develop end user technical documentation, training materials and team cross-training.

• All other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, technical, or business-related discipline (such as Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, or Business Administration), or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a data, analytics, technology, or business-related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Experience: 5+ years in employer benefits or related field focused in analytics/business intelligence delivery.

• Proven track record as an individual contributor owning tools, workflows, and enablement processes with minimal oversight.

• Extensive experience with business intelligence exploratory or visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, ThoughtSpot).

• Ability to organize, facilitate, and lead productive meetings with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a focus on broader business objectives.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.

• A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and to protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

data.job_title: Reporting Analyst - Power BI, BI Tools, Healthcare
data.job_description:
Oracle Health Government Services is seeking a skilled Reporting Analyst to join our mission-driven organization. The Reporting Analyst will work closely with government stakeholders, integration leadership, data management teams, and project managers to ensure accurate, timely, and reliable reporting in support of deployment, integration, escalation, and executive decision-making.

This role manages complex schedule creation for a wide variety of applications and systems used by the client. The position serves as an important member of our integration team, supporting the scheduling activities required for delivery of all interface-related deployment activities. The ideal candidate will have proven success working with development teams as well as other internal stakeholders to provide information required for meeting contract deadlines.

Responsibilities:

• Ensure quality assurance and data integrity across all reports, dashboards, and data extracts.

• Monitor, maintain, and update reporting and interface tracking artifacts using SharePoint and other enterprise tools.

• Collect, validate, analyze, and reconcile qualitative and quantitative data from multiple data sources.

• Work within established communication and governance processes to receive, document, and disseminate updates from integration of leadership, change management, and reporting teams.

• Coordinate with internal teams (Microsoft Project Manager, JIRA, Data Management, CGS Analytics, Power BI, Apex) to ensure reporting updates align with deployment milestones, localization activities, and cutover events.

• Prepare, review, and distribute recurring and ad hoc reports to internal leadership and government clients.

• Draft clear, concise PowerPoint presentations and executive-level briefing materials.

• Support escalation reporting, executive briefings, and stakeholder communications.

• Attend and/or facilitate internal and external meetings as required

• Attend and/or facilitate external client meetings, including list synchronization meetings.

• Produce executive-level reports and dashboards.

Top skills or competencies to be successful:

• Business Intelligence Reporting experience

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills.

• Highly organized and detail oriented.

Education, certifications, or experience (preferred/required):

• Bachelor’s plus a minimum of 5 years of reporting, business intelligence, or data analysis experience.

• Highly proficient in Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, and PowerBI.

• Efficient with written and oral communication

• Familiar with Office 365 applications such as Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.

• Experience with Milestone Pro preferred

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills.

• Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across multiple levels of management.

• Previous Federal Contracting experience preferred.

• Required travel up to 20%

• US Citizenship is required with an ability to obtain and maintain a government security clearance.

About the Team/Role
The Business Intelligence Analyst 2 will balance their time between providing wide analytics support to multiple lines of business and providing dedicated support for our largest and most complex strategic partnerships within the North American Fleet line of business.
The Analyst will dive deep into complex business challenges, utilizing data from internal and external sources to provide clear, actionable insights for decision-makers. This role will involve more than just collecting data; it will require identifying hidden patterns and trends within datasets to understand the underlying factors that influence business performance.

The Analyst will use this knowledge, combined with a strong understanding of the market, to construct accurate forecasts, develop insightful recommendations, and contribute to strategic and tactical planning. They will translate complex data into digestible reports and analyses, tailoring their approach to meet specific business needs and utilizing available data elements effectively. Beyond simply presenting data, the Analyst will act as a consultant, providing guidance to business partners and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve pressing business problems. They will also possess the technical skills to generate datasets and reports using system reporting tools, ensuring the organization has the information it needs to succeed.

How you'll make an impact
The successful candidate will be pro-active and creative, with an insatiable curiosity and desire to understand not only what has transpired, but why. They will enjoy inspiring others by delivering actionable insights and will always think and act in our strategic partners’ best interest. Traveling to present at strategic offsite meetings may be required.

ANALYSIS & REPORTING:
• Utilize enterprise data platforms, Business Intelligence platforms and data visualization tools for data discovery and storytelling. Preferred experience in Snowflake, Tableau and Business Objects.

• Create and maintain datasets, dashboards and proprietary systems in support of analytical duties.

• Development and deployment of dashboards, trend analysis, operational reporting to key stakeholder groups.

• Develop both custom and ad-hoc reports as necessary to identify, illustrate, and monitor trends and issues within the portfolios for both the US and Canada.

• Perform ongoing analysis of data, changes, trends and other relevant patterns.

• Analyze industry trends and provide competitive benchmarking.

• Conduct self-directed investigations into data irregularities and proactively identify opportunities for service improvement and potential system issues.

• Fulfill all prioritized departmental ad hoc report requests from the Sales and Marketing teams.

• Provide insight and direction to the “Four A’s” of portfolio analysis and reporting: Acquisition, Approval, Activation and Attrition.

• Forecast portfolio volume against contractual obligations on a monthly basis.

COLLABORATION & QUALITY ASSURANCE:
• Partner with Service Delivery leadership to identify both broad and individual coaching needs, make recommendations based on data analysis, and develop and maintain a system for tracking and reporting out results to stakeholders on a recurring basis.

• Collaborate with Management to explore, evaluate and initiate revenue enhancement opportunities, program/product enhancements, and process improvements.

• Partner cross-functionally to strategically leverage relationships with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Product, IT and Finance.

Summary

The Ladies Professional Golf Association (LPGA) is the world’s premier women’s professional golf organization. Through the LPGA Tour, the Epson Tour, the LPGA Professionals, and a joint venture with the Ladies European Tour, the LPGA provides female professionals the opportunity to pursue their dreams in the game of golf at the highest level.
